description: Two sine oscillators with a phase difference between them, brought out as the larger of the two and as the first clipped by the second

params.text: Sets the pitch of both oscillators, -8 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 1Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation
Sets how far the second oscillator is shifted against the first, 0 to 100 per cent of a cycle
Attenuates the voltage at the Phs jack before it is added to the Phs knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Puts the phase of both oscillators back to the start of the cycle

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the first oscillator by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Sets the pitch of the second oscillator by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob; with nothing patched here both oscillators run at the same pitch
Modulates that shift, -5V to 5V scaled by the Phs CV knob
Modulates the frequency of both oscillators through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself
A trigger here puts the phase of both oscillators back to the start of the cycle

outputs.text: Whichever of the two waves is the higher at that moment
The first wave held inside the size of the second, which folds it back on itself where it goes past

notes: while the two V/Oct jacks are set to different pitches the phase shift drifts, because the two oscillators only line up again when their pitches match
menu: Oversample — works the two waves out sixteen times over per sample and filters them, which cuts the aliasing the clipping brings in; it comes up off

inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the V/Oct 1 jack.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Phs knob alone.
inputs.3:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.4:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
